items.title: Joe Temperley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: The saxophone section was Jerome Richardson and Jerry Dodgion and Joe Farrell and Eddie Daniels and myself.

ctx.x: That was quite a roster of — everyone was a soloist.
The saxophone section was Jerome Richardson and Jerry Dodgion and Joe Farrell and Eddie Daniels and myself. It was amazing.
That’s great. 1974 was a pretty significant year for the Ellington—
